name: Send Email
description: Send an email using SMTP credentials.

properties.name: recipients
properties.description: Email recipients. Can add multiple To, CC, and BCC recipients.

properties.name: attachments
properties.description: Files to attach to the email. Can reference files from previous nodes.

fields.name: content
fields.description: File content (base64 encoded) or reference to file data

fields.name: contentType
fields.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., application/pdf, image/png)
